aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: All primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The parser_to_client dependency is the primary signal because high-level IMAPClient commands are sensitive to stale typed parser return shapes.
The lexer_to_parser dependency captures stale assumptions around token boundaries and IMAP literal handling.
The utility_to_client dependency captures stale bytes/str, date, and IMAP UTF-7 normalization assumptions.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Lexer tokenization, literal handling, and IMAP protocol assertion contracts must be stable before parser tuple and typed-object parsing can be correct.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when lexer literal/string probes and parser literal/tuple probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The parser agent may implement parsing around stale token boundary, literal, or protocol assertion behavior.

dependency_points.contract_summary: High-level IMAPClient search/fetch/status/store behavior must consume SearchIds, fetch dictionaries, UID keys, and typed response objects from the parser consistently.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when parser typed response probes and client search/fetch consumer probes pass together after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The client agent may implement search or fetch normalization around stale parser output shapes, SearchIds.modseq, or UID-vs-message-id semantics.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Client command construction consumes date formatting, IMAP UTF-7 folder encoding, fixed-offset datetime behavior, and bytes/text helper contracts.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when utility/date/UTF-7 probes and client command/folder probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The client agent may hard-code command argument or folder decoding assumptions that diverge from the utility layer.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves IMAPClient lexer, parser, typed response, utility normalization, and high-level client command contracts.
